_owner: owner: autom8y-workflows maintainers, changed only in a reviewed PR when the account changes. account_sha256 is the sha256 of the fleet CodeArtifact account id; the id itself is never written here. A repository's hosts change only in a reviewed PR. An unlisted repository gets an empty allowlist (CodeArtifact only); a listed repository must have a uv.lock. autom8y/autom8y-workflows is the one row that names PyPI hosts (pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org, no direct hosts): its uv.lock is dev-only test tooling for this repository's own CI (pytest and pyyaml), never deployed, and holds no autom8y-* package; autom8y-* packages stay CodeArtifact-only under every row.
